question: On August 15, 2025, how long did Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s Independence Day speech last?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**103 minutes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• 79th Independence Day: At 103 minutes, PM Modi delivers longest Independence Day speech.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Date & Occasion:** August 15, 2025, 79th Independence Day.

 
 
• 
 
**Location:** Red Fort, Delhi.

 
 
• 
 
**Duration:** **103 minutes** – longest I-Day address by any Indian PM.

 
 
• 
 
Surpassed his own **2024 record of 98 minutes**.

 
 
• 
 
**12th consecutive speech** since 2014.

 
 
• 
 
**Second-longest consecutive streak** after Nehru (17 speeches).

 
 
• 
 
**Speech Durations (select years):**

 
 
• 
 
2014: 65 mins (first)

 
 
• 
 
2015: 88 mins

 
 
• 
 
2016: 96 mins

 
 
• 
 
2017: 56 mins (shortest)

 
 
• 
 
2018: 83 mins

 
 
• 
 
2019: 92 mins

 
 
• 
 
2020: 90 mins (pandemic year)

 
 
• 
 
2021: 88 mins

 
 
• 
 
2022: 74 mins

 
 
• 
 
2023: 90 mins

 
 
• 
 
2024: 98 mins (previous record)

 
 
• 
 
2025: **103 mins (new record)**
